utterance: create a AWS codebuild project resource with example iam role and buildbatch configuration. Give the project an IAM role of its own, have it build the GitHub repository `https://github.com/mitchellh/packer.git`, and write its artifacts out to the existing S3 bucket whose name starts with `build-artifacts-` rather than standing up a bucket of your own. Its build batch configuration runs as that same role and allows exactly as many concurrent builds as this account holds its builds to.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: a CodeBuild project that did not exist at the start builds a source of type GITHUB, writes its primary artifacts as type S3 into the pre-existing build-artifacts store, runs as an IAM role that did not exist at the start, was created for this project and is trusted by codebuild.amazonaws.com, and carries a build batch configuration whose service role is that same new role and whose maximum concurrent builds allowed is the concurrent-build allowance the account's own in-service builds are held to when the work is finished
